title: Review changes
against_empty: No commit yet: every file is new
against_branch: Files on disk against where it left {ref} ({sha})
pick_commit_detail: Everything that changed since the commit you pick, up to the files on disk.
stale: The files changed since this was read.
summary: Leave a summary for the agent (optional)
not_sent: The review wasn't sent. It's still here.
no_box: This chat's message box isn't open. Use Add to message box instead.
composed_one: {count} comment added to the message box
composed_other: {count} comments added to the message box
read_only: This chat doesn't take messages, so comments can't be sent from here.
refused: Not shown: this file holds secrets.
too_big: This file's diff is too big to show here.
clean_uncommitted_detail: Everything on disk is committed. The branch may still have changes to review.
clean_branch: Nothing changed since this branch left {ref}
clean_branch_detail: Its commits and the files on disk match where it started.
not_git: This folder isn't a Git repository
outdated: Update this computer to review changes
outdated_detail: Its personad is from before reviews. Update it, then open this again.
no_default_branch: No default branch to compare with
no_default_branch_detail: There's no origin/HEAD, main or master. Review the uncommitted changes, or pick a commit.
no_merge_base: This branch has nothing in common with the default branch
bad_commit: That commit isn't in this repository
bad_base: That branch isn't in this repository
